svg.title: Holomorphic traces and incidence coefficient maps
svg.desc: The actual coefficient trace is (2 pi i) to the minus N times minus one to N times q minus N times fibre integration. The ordered Cauchy class has r N equal minus one to N times N minus one over two; the normalized diagonal trace is the identity. The forward closed-to-extension-by-zero comparison is inverted, while the reverse derived-open-image-to-closed comparison is used in its original direction. The displayed maps use actual inverse derivative denominators. General inverse-pair and compatible module-action comparisons remain separate.
svg.text: Holomorphic traces and incidence coefficient maps
Proper density evaluation · every-degree signs · actual localized source maps
1. Integrate the shifted density with its exact sign
TYq = qN (−1)N(q−N) Iq , q ≥ N
qN = (2πi)−N ; TYq = 0 for q < N.
R pX! HXY[N] → OX
The source differential is (−1)N ∂̄; the trace is a chain map in every degree.
Joint holomorphic coefficients multiply before proper trace.
Actual vector evaluation and ordinary composition: HIC.1–HIC.11.
2. The diagonal class has a fixed normal sign
Its full form is the ordered product of ∂̄(1/wi) ∧ dwi.
The positive period is (2πi)N; qN (2πi)N = 1.
Therefore the diagonal coefficient map acts as the identity on O.
N = 2: omitting r2 gives −1; retaining it gives +1.
The complete current/connecting convention is HIC.12–HIC.14, HIC.23.
3. Keep the two source comparisons in their actual directions
c+ : ΦJ+ OY → ΦK OY
c− : ΦL OX → ΦJ− OX
Their projected constant cones are invisible at nonzero output covectors.
ϑ+ = (DtN)−1 ϑu+,N c+−1
Inverse derivatives are localized denominators, with τ ≠ 0 or σ ≠ 0.
General inverse-pair and module-action comparisons remain required.
N = 1: ϑ+ = c+−1 and ϑ− = c−.
Source arrows, vector roofs and Cauchy calibration: HIC.17–HIC.22, HIC.26–HIC.30.
